card.name: Limiting words before a restriction
card.fires_on: Small words in phrases that set a limit or permission, such as 'may', 'no' before 'more than', 'not to take', and 'no more than'. It fires on the word just before the limit is spelled out.

modes.label: Limit phrases
modes.description: Words inside 'no more than', 'not exceeding', 'not to take extra' that cap an amount.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of QUVIVIQ is 25 mg no more<< than>> once per night when used with moderate inhibitors

modes.label: Permission or exclusion
modes.description: Words like 'may' or 'precludes' that grant or rule out something.
modes.example: You may need to sponge-bathe until your doctor says you<< may>> shower or bathe sitting in the tub

modes.label: Missed-dose wording
modes.description: The verb after 'not to' in missed-dose instructions.
modes.example: If a dose of REZUROCK is missed, instruct the patient to not<< take>> extra doses to make up the missed dose

card.writes: It suppresses 'only'-type words in English and Chinese, so it steers toward limit wording other than 'only'.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in phrases that set a limit, like 'no more than' or 'do not take extra'.
